visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair, wearing a grey knitted beret and a denim jacket, has four green-onion-shaped flutes in her mouth. She blows into them simultaneously with her eyes closed, while white speed-line graphics burst from her face. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of her blowing into a single white and green flute. A green square with the number '087' appears above her head, and the background changes to a purple digital environment with pink-clad figures, referencing the 'Squid Game' aesthetic. (3) She smiles at the camera, holding a cardboard box filled with colorful gachapon capsules. A graphic of a green onion flute's packaging is overlaid in the center. (4) She holds a white and green flute, rotating it to show the holes on the front and back. (5) A montage appears showing her playing the flute in five horizontal bars, each representing a different note/finger position. (6) She unboxes a green flute with brown 'grilled' marks and a pinkish 'red onion' flute. Animated butterflies appear around her as she plays the pink flute. (7) She shows a green-and-white fabric case shaped like a vegetable bag. (8) The video ends with her putting all flutes in her mouth again, blowing hard with a humorous, strained expression while warning text overlays the bottom of the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A series of sharp, discordant whistling bursts opens the audio, accompanied by energetic, fast-paced female speech in a high register. (2) Upbeat, quirky electronic background music plays. A brief, staccato flute melody (three notes) is heard, punctuating the vocal delivery. (3) Soft plastic rustling is heard as items are unboxed, followed by high-pitched 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects marking scene transitions. (4) The speaker's tone remains cheerful and slightly exaggerated. Individual flute notes are demonstrated, sounding thin and shrill. (5) The audio concludes with a repeated sequence of chaotic, loud whistles and a comical 'impact' sound effect, matching the visual of the speaker blowing multiple flutes.
